## v0.2.22
- **Graphics Update (small demo)**
  - Sun with lensflares

  - Several minor bug fixes

Vortex Studio is coming out within the next couple of days (more precise release time will be posted shortly)! The first version will include enough tools to create **anything that is currently in Vortex**, and we will quickly add support for lighting, team create, scripting, and more. ## v0.2.16

- HEAVY optimizations:
  - Reduced draw calls by up to 20-30x based depending on the game
  - Better caching for player labels, bubble chat, and clothing
  - Single-frame hashmap generation with O(1) lookups (mostly)
- **50 player server cap**
  - This was designed such that it will be configurable for developers in the future with Vortex Studio
  - Server instances dynamically get created/deleted based on player count
  - Server selection UI on each game's page
  - Queue system
    - When requesting to join a full server, you'll be put in a queue until a slot becomes available
- 20 minute inactivity kick (the high CCU was nice, but it's not fully accurate with most people being AFK)
- **New stud textures**
- Bug fixes:
  - Fixed players joining empty servers
  - Fixed only 8 people loading while the rest "left the game"
  - Fixed loading getting stuck on "Loading player info..." when switching servers too quickly
  - Fixed stale data when players left the game 
  - Fixed players being able to move when kicked
  - Fixed joining a server taking you back to the home page
  - Fixed many in-game notifications for friend requests and follows not showing
- Improved downloading/updating speeds
- Improved rate-limiting

Note: there is currently an issue where the queue sometimes gets stuck forever and doesn't put you in a server, which will be fixed in the next update. I'll also be adding an updated roadmap to the website so you can know what to expect in the near future for Vortex!

Thank you for all the recent support, and if you're new here, WELCOME TO VORTEX!! <@&1496641306179408003> 
-# https://discord.com/channels/1496551960294199386/1496780713192587316/1530700345779687474

- **Account deletion functionality in [settings](https://playvortex.io/settings)**:
  - Upon requesting a deletion, your account and its data will be held for **7 days**. You can cancel the deletion before that by logging in, but after this time expires, your data will not be recovered.
- Bug fixes:
  - Fixed issues with 2FA not allowing login
  - Fixed issues with joining the game + app authentication not syncing
- Minor UI Improvements

- MAJOR site-wide optimizations and performance improvements (pages should load in a fraction of a second after initial caching)
- Revamped footer
- Fixed new profile pictures not being generated
